summary: Implemented rich_measure for Tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter per the spec. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative depth-first walk with explicit stack, four cells of indent per level) and imports Measurement; rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, a width constraint in rendering (measured max, or min of that and explicit width), and a new VerticalCenter class with render, measurement, and repr; rich/console.py sets justify="default" in collected render options while still passing justify into _collect_renderables; tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py gained the specified imports and tests; CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as UNRELEASED with an Added subsection. Nothing was run or committed, so the tests are unverified. Choices: hook named __rich_measure__, and the Added subsection sits below the existing markdown entry.
